messages:
Priya (People Ops): Heads-up — final round for SRE candidate tomorrow 10:30am PT. Need debrief owner + scribe and to confirm rubric weights. Jordan flagged a calendar clash. Calendar: https://calendar.app/event/abcd1234 Recording consent doc: https://drive/repo/consent — please confirm ASAP :spiral_note_pad:
Aisha (People Ops): I can be scribe. Which rubric version are we using? infra rubric has a couple variants.
Samir (Eng): I can take debrief owner if Jordan can't. @Jordan are you able to confirm availability?
Jordan (Eng): Sorry heads-up — running on another sync that ends ~11:00. I can still do the debrief owner but might join late. If candidate timing is strict at 10:30 I can provide async notes after.
Elena (Interviewer): I can run the interview and capture the first 10m of notes, then hand over. Need the Zoom link and transcript access. Also candidate requested a11y accommodation — ok to record?
Priya (People Ops): @Jordan async is fine if you can't make live. Rubric = infra-deep-dive-v2 (last edit 2026-03-10). Quick checklist attached below.
Priya (People Ops) ```Checklist:
- Confirm debrief owner + scribe
- Ensure rubric infra-deep-dive-v2 loaded
- Zoom link + recording enabled, consent noted
- Link scorecard in debrief doc
- One-paragraph candidate summary for hiring committee```
PanelBot: Meeting updated — Zoom link set to https://zoom.us/j/1234567890, recording enabled by organizer.
Samir (Eng): Added debrief doc: https://docs.company/debriefs/sre-final-jdoe and assigned Aisha as scribe in the doc.
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks — can someone paste the rubric weights here so I can pre-fill the scorecard?
Priya (People Ops): Weights: Technical 60, System Design 20, Collaboration/Communication 20. Use the infra-deep-dive-v2 scorecard in the drive.
Jordan (Eng): Quick normalization note for debrief: if an interviewer skips a section, mark it N/A in the scorecard; final average should exclude N/A fields. Saves follow-up fights later.
Elena (Interviewer): Recording ok with candidate (they confirmed). I'll check transcript access rights and share with the hiring committee after debrief.
Aisha (People Ops): I'll capture timestamps for key segments and flag any accommodation notes in the doc.
Samir (Eng): If Jordan can't make live, I'll be debrief owner per above. Also quick ask — can we have one fallback question set for the short variant? I added 3 short probes to the doc.
Jordan (Eng): If I drop, Samir please take over — thanks.
Priya (People Ops): Great — I'll update the calendar (add note: "If owner not present, Samir will chair debrief") and send a 1h reminder. Please keep comments in the debrief doc, not replies here. :rocket:
Jordan (Eng): :thumbsup:
Elena (Interviewer): All set from my side. See you all tomorrow.
Aisha (People Ops): All good — I'll be ready to scribe and will ping 15min before to confirm access.
